claims: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is voluntary.
TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is available to PreCheck members at 65+ airports as of Spring 2026.
TSA PreCheck Touchless ID uses facial recognition instead of physical ID.
Travelers opt-in to TSA PreCheck Touchless ID via participating airline apps.
Travelers upload a passport to create a digital identifier for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.
Travelers scan their face at a dedicated terminal-based camera upon arrival for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.
The dedicated terminal-based camera compares the face scan against the traveler's passport photo.
TSA PreCheck Touchless ID allows travelers to pass through security without presenting a boarding pass or physical ID.
United is a participating airline app for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.
Southwest is a participating airline app for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.
KTN stands for Known Traveler Number.
The TSA states that face images are not used for law enforcement or surveillance.
The TSA states that face images are not shared with other entities.
TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is expanding to over 65 airports.
Participating airports for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID include ATL, DTW, JFK, and LGA.
Travelers can opt out of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at any time.
Opting out of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID returns travelers to standard document checks.
The biometric technology used in TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is nearly 99% accurate.
